changes: Legends as tables: columns and rows from your column labels (stress ratio, confining pressure…), with merged cells and borders. Insert > Table puts a table of your own on a graph.
Plot samples in any text: \l(n) draws plot n's line or symbol in a text box, an axis title or a table cell, and follows the plot when it changes.
Equations in any text, set as Word sets them: fractions, roots, sums, brackets. An equation editor with symbol palettes, ready-made formulas, upright words and drag to select (∑ button or Alt+=).
Titles, text boxes and table cells are typed right on the graph, equations and samples included; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
Patina Plot now tells you when a new version is out, with what it brings: update now, later, or skip that version (File > Check for updates).
Fixes: square roots get their bar, the Objects list shows symbols filled or hollow and lines dashed as drawn, legend samples use the symbol edge width.
For AI assistants (MCP): graph_add_table, graph_table_set and graph_legend_table.
